target.statement: AADI-RPN achieves AR100 of 55.3 on COCO val-2017, compared to 45.7 for standard RPN (Table 1).

compute.basis: Training RPN on COCO train-2017 with 1x schedule takes ~4.2 hours on 8 V100 GPUs; on a single GPU it would take much longer, and CPU-only training is infeasible.

blockers: Requires GPU for training (paper uses 8 V100 GPUs)
